cards: Ramesses III was a pharaoh of the Twentieth Dynasty of the Egyptian New Kingdom.
assassinated c. 1153 BCE · Egypt & North Africa
Nebuchadnezzar I was a king of Babylon in the late twelfth century BCE, of the Second Dynasty of Isin.
r. c. 1125–1104 BCE · Ancient Near East
Shutruk-Nahhunte was a king of Elam of the Shutrukid dynasty in the twelfth century BCE.
r. c. 1185–1155 BCE · Ancient Near East
Shilhak-Inshushinak was a king of Elam in the twelfth century BCE of the Shutrukid dynasty.
r. c. 1150–1120 BCE · Ancient Near East
Enlil-nadin-ahi was the last king of the Kassite dynasty of Babylonia, ruling for about three years in the mid-12th century BCE.
reigned c. 1157–1155 BCE · Ancient Near East
Tausret, also spelled Tawosret or Twosret, was the last known ruler of the Nineteenth Dynasty of Egypt.
